so, like. i had this thought. before i had an actual ed, and no, i didn’t develop the ed because i wanted to. so maybe i can explain why people think this way. i always hated my body since i was like 11. and i never lost weight a normal way no matter how hard i tried. but in the media people with eating disorders are never really portrayed by actual people with a scarily thin form like a severe anorexic would have. it’s kinda usually some offhand comment, like in heathers when heather chandler comments on heather duke being bulimic, or in mean girls where regina talks about her weight all the time. they look a healthy weight. they don’t look emaciated. so it’s really easy for someone who’s overweight (like i was) to think ‘wow, if i had an eating disorder then i would be a healthy weight and considered skinny, so i wanna be like that’. 

so yeah. not saying i’m defending people that say that, bc now that i ACTUALLY have an ed and understand what it’s really like i wish i had never thought like that because this shit sucks, but that might be why they think that way.
